blocks.text: Fulfilling the commands of Allah concerning the servants of Allah in the way of the Prophet ﷺ. In this, the status of Muslims must be kept in mind.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَعَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ مُّشْرِكٍ وَّلَوْ أَعْجَبَكُمْ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: A believing slave is better than a man who associates partners - even though he (with his beauty and wealth) may attract you.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَوَمَنْ كَانَ مَيْتاً فَأَحْيَيْنهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُ نُورًا يَّمْشِي بِهِ فِي النَّاسِ كَمَنْ مَّثَلُهُ فِي الظُّلُمتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِّنْهَا۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: Is one who was dead, and then We gave him life and made for him a light (too), by which he walks among people, like one who is in darkness (of disbelief) from which he cannot come out?

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِناً كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقاً ؕ لَاَيَسْتَوُونَ۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: Is then one who has become a believer like one who has become a sinner? (The two) are not equal.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالََ تَعَالي: (ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتبَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا۞)
blocks.tamil_translation: Then We made those whom We chose from among Our servants heirs to (Our) Book.
